content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Jr. Project Officer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Jr. Project Officer post at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Jr. Project Officer position at IIT Guwahati is 21st August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Jr. Project Officer role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Jr. Project Officer position, candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Science or a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Design.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Jr. Project Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Jr. Project Officer position in the IIT Guwahati recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Project Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Jr. Project Officer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 27,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Jr. Project Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Jr. Project Officer recruitment at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Jr. Project Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Jr. Project Officer position will primarily involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an age limit for the Jr. Project Officer position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for the Jr. Project Officer position. Candidates are advised to check the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Jr. Project Officer recruitment at IIT Guwahati is strictly online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Jr. Project Officer position?
faq.answer: The Jr. Project Officer position at IIT Guwahati is offered on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website of IIT Guwahati is also provided there.
